summary.en-US: Configurable publisher watchlists and formal post-publication signals for scholarly literature.

version.approval_notes: This update keeps Gecko ID browser-extension@notandia.github.io. The source package is readable, with no minification, remote code, runtime npm dependencies or telemetry. Publisher and journal warnings run locally using bundled Wikimedia snapshots (CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution included). Manual publisher profiles and import/export remain available. Crossref and NCBI requests are off by default; the setup prompt offers activation or individual choices. Firefox optional websiteContent permission is required for either provider. Crossref receives DOI identifiers; NCBI receives DOI, PMID or PMCID identifiers and public application contact metadata. Requests omit cookies and referrers. Turning off a provider stops its requests. Pages, citation text, search queries and browsing history stay local. Privacy policy: https://notandia.pages.dev/privacy/firefox/ Version 0.1.6 corrects shared-helper access in Firefox content-script sandboxes: consumers now read helpers from globalThis, matching their registration, rather than window. Regression tests reproduce missing reference scanning with distinct sandbox/window objects and verify Wikipedia/PubMed reference highlighting after the fix. No new permissions or data uses. Physical Android confirmation is pending.
